geometry_node.comment.common.flow_out: Continues execution after this node finishes.
geometry_node.comment.common.flow_true: Triggers when the condition is true.
geometry_node.comment.common.flow_false: Triggers when the condition is false or empty.
geometry_node.comment.common.loop: Triggers once for each loop iteration.
geometry_node.comment.common.completed: Triggers when the loop or batch operation completes.
geometry_node.comment.common.case: Controls whether the matching output branch is triggered.
geometry_node.comment.common.entity: The entity used by this node.
geometry_node.comment.common.player: The player that triggered the event or operation.
geometry_node.comment.common.trigger_ent: The entity that triggered this area check.
geometry_node.comment.common.source_enti: The entity used as a visual attachment or emitter.
geometry_node.comment.common.item_stack: The item stack used by this operation.
geometry_node.comment.common.leftover_it: The leftover item stack that could not be inserted.
geometry_node.comment.common.result_item: The item stack copy after the operation.
geometry_node.comment.common.removed_cou: The number of items actually removed.
geometry_node.comment.common.block_stats: Changed block counts grouped by block ID.
geometry_node.comment.common.min_int: The minimum endpoint of the integer iteration range.
geometry_node.comment.common.max_int: The maximum endpoint of the integer iteration range.
geometry_node.comment.common.index: The current loop index or matched result index.
geometry_node.comment.common.limit: Maximum amount to process; values at or below 0 usually mean unlimited.
geometry_node.comment.common.completed_p: Controls whether completed waits for loop branches to finish.
geometry_node.comment.common.type: Type, mode, or actual registry ID.
geometry_node.comment.common.count_mode: Controls whether item stack count participates in comparison.
geometry_node.comment.common.container: The checked container value, string, list, map, or registry object.
geometry_node.comment.common.tags: The registry tags owned by the value.
geometry_node.comment.common.tag: The tag to match, using namespace:path or #namespace:path.
geometry_node.comment.common.match_mode: Controls how item stacks or registry values are matched.
geometry_node.comment.common.scope: Selects the inventory, equipment, container, or entity item-handler scope.
geometry_node.comment.common.slot_in: The slot reference saved by the slot editor.
geometry_node.comment.common.target_item: The item data saved by the item picker.
geometry_node.comment.common.include_emp: Whether empty slots are included in the query result.
geometry_node.comment.common.normal: The reflection or hit normal, normalized during calculation.
geometry_node.comment.common.xyz: World position, hit position, or schematic origin.
geometry_node.comment.common.radius: Radius, hit expansion, or view distance.
geometry_node.comment.common.penetrate_e: Whether entities are penetrated and collection continues.
geometry_node.comment.common.is_hit: Whether this trace hit a block or entity.
geometry_node.comment.common.translation: Translation offset for the item visual; supports dynamic expressions.
geometry_node.comment.common.path: Relative schematic file path under the server asset directory.
geometry_node.comment.common.path_out: The schematic file path actually used.
geometry_node.comment.common.key: Unique key for a schematic projection or placement record.
geometry_node.comment.common.debug: When enabled, only sends a visual projection; when disabled, writes to the world.
geometry_node.comment.common.only_self_v: Whether the projection is visible only to the triggering player.
geometry_node.comment.common.unique_if_e: Whether to append a suffix when the key already exists.
geometry_node.comment.common.replace_air: Whether schematic air clears target positions.
geometry_node.comment.common.replace_blo: Whether existing non-air blocks are overwritten.
geometry_node.comment.common.mirror: Negative X/Z mirrors across the matching axis.
geometry_node.comment.common.repair_air: Whether repair restores air positions from the placement record.
geometry_node.comment.common.affect_enti: Whether entities spawned by this schematic placement are affected.
geometry_node.comment.common.output_cent: The center point used by this area check.
geometry_node.comment.common.input_cente: Area center offset or world position.
geometry_node.comment.common.trigger_id: The area trigger ID for this check.
geometry_node.comment.common.inside_coun: The number of entities currently inside the area.
geometry_node.comment.common.shape: Area shape, which controls the available size ports.
geometry_node.comment.common.target: Entity type filter applied before the area query.
geometry_node.comment.common.interval: Area check interval; keep at 1 for high-speed checks.
geometry_node.comment.common.container_t: Container menu registry ID; empty matches all containers.
geometry_node.comment.common.name: Display name.
geometry_node.node.if_branch.comment.sum: Selects an execution branch from a boolean input.
geometry_node.node.switch.comment.summar: Dispatches execution through multiple boolean case inputs, with dynamically expandable output branches.
Merges multiple execution inputs into one execution output.
geometry_node.node.for_loop.comment.summ: Repeats the loop branch over an inclusive integer range, with reverse iteration and cross-tick scheduling support.
geometry_node.node.for_each_loop.comment: Iterates a list and repeats the loop branch while outputting the current index and element.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.su: Repeats the loop body while the condition is true; tick 0 runs synchronously and positive values schedule across ticks.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.lo: Triggers the current iteration while the condition is true. Avoid long delays in the body when using cross-tick mode.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.co: Triggers when the condition becomes false. It is not triggered when the synchronous safety limit is exceeded.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.it: The current loop iteration, starting at 0.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.fl: Starts the loop and resets the iteration to 0.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.co: Re-evaluated before every iteration; false ends the loop.
geometry_node.node.while_loop.comment.ti: Ticks between iterations. 0 runs synchronously; positive values run across ticks.
geometry_node.node.equal.comment.summary: Checks whether two values are equal, with type, registry ID, component, and strict modes.
geometry_node.node.contain.comment.summa: Checks whether one value contains another, including strings, lists, maps, and tag matching.
geometry_node.node.has_tag.comment.summa: Checks whether a value belongs to a registry tag.
geometry_node.node.get_tags.comment.summ: Gets the registry tags owned by a value.
geometry_node.node.reflect_vector.commen: Reflects a vector by a normal, useful for projectile bounce velocity calculations.
Formats text with strict {name} placeholders; missing variables keep their placeholders.
geometry_node.node.string_expression.com: Concatenates a string expression, for example "HP: " + A + "/" + B.
geometry_node.node.math_expression.comme: Evaluates a custom math expression with common operators, functions, and A-Z dynamic variables.
geometry_node.node.get_slot.comment.summ: Creates a slot reference that describes a position but not item contents.
geometry_node.node.get_slot_item.comment: Reads the item stack in a target entity slot and outputs whether it is non-empty and its count.
geometry_node.node.slot_from_index.comme: Converts a numeric index into a slot reference, wrapping fixed-capacity ranges.
geometry_node.node.pick_item_stack.comme: Creates an item stack constant through the item picker UI.
Counts items matching a condition in the target primary item storage.
Finds slots matching a condition in a target entity or container.
geometry_node.node.add_item_to_inventory: Inserts an item stack into the target primary item storage.
geometry_node.node.remove_items_from_inv: Removes matching items from the target primary item storage.
geometry_node.node.set_slot_item.comment: Writes an item stack into a target entity slot.
geometry_node.node.drop_slot_item.commen: Extracts items from a slot and drops them at the target entity position.
geometry_node.node.clear_slots.comment.s: Clears slots in a target entity or container by scope.
geometry_node.node.set_item_count.commen: Sets an item stack count without changing the item type or components.
geometry_node.node.clear_all_attribute_m: Clears all attribute modifier components from an item stack.
geometry_node.node.get_item_damage.comme: Reads the current durability damage of an item stack.
geometry_node.node.get_item_durability.c: Reads the remaining durability of an item stack.
geometry_node.node.get_item_id.comment.s: Reads the item stack registry ID.
geometry_node.node.get_item_max_damage.c: Reads the maximum durability damage of an item stack.
geometry_node.node.get_item_max_stack_si: Reads the maximum stack size of an item stack.
geometry_node.node.get_item_name.comment: Reads the display name of an item stack.
Checks whether an item stack has a custom name.
geometry_node.node.has_item_enchantments: Checks whether an item stack has enchantment data.
geometry_node.node.is_item_damageable.co: Checks whether an item stack supports durability damage.
geometry_node.node.is_item_empty.comment: Checks whether an item stack is empty.
geometry_node.node.raycast.comment.summa: Runs one raycast from a start position along a direction and reuses cached outputs within the same execution.
geometry_node.node.multi_raycast.comment: Runs a penetrable pitch/yaw/distance raycast and outputs sorted hit entities.
geometry_node.node.draw_debug_line.comme: Draws a temporary debug line; this is visual only.
geometry_node.node.draw_laser_beam.comme: Draws a temporary laser beam visual that can bind to source and target entities.
geometry_node.node.draw_ray_beam.comment: Emits a temporary ray beam visual from source_entity and does not output hit results.
geometry_node.node.draw_item_visual.comm: Draws a temporary item visual that can follow an entity or use a world-space offset.
geometry_node.node.remove_schematic_proj: Removes a schematic projection visual by key without changing world blocks or placement records.
geometry_node.node.revert_schematic_plac: Removes a schematic placement by key and restores the world to its before-placement state.
geometry_node.node.repair_schematic_plac: Restores a schematic placement by key to the state it had immediately after placement.
geometry_node.node.create_schematic_proj: Projects or places a .schem/.schematic at a position and maintains the projection or placement record by key.
geometry_node.node.area_trigger_event.co: Detects entities entering, staying in, or leaving an area volume; matching area configs in the same graph share the underlying query.
geometry_node.node.on_container_open.com: Triggers when a player opens a container screen.
geometry_node.node.get_input_data_type.c: Recognizes INTEGER, LONG, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, STRING, RICH_TEXT, COLOR, GEOMETRY, SLOT, ENTITY, ITEM_STACK, DIALOGUE_CHOICE, LIST, DICT, and XYZ.
DynamicData, Item, Block, BlockState, UUID, native arrays, and other unlisted objects are not directly recognized; these values and null return ANY.
